headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, while the New York Mets secured a thrilling 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves. The Minnesota Twins took down the Baltimore Orioles 9-5, and the Philadelphia Phillies edged the St. Louis Cardinals in a hard-fought 6-5 win.

Top performers included Brett Baty, who hit a home run and drove in four runs for the Mets, and Josh Bell, who led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Andrew Painter earned the win for the Phillies, while Brent Suter pitched three scoreless innings in relief for the Mets.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Daniel Susac of the San Francisco Giants, who suffered a left knee patella fracture, and Tyler Freeman of the Colorado Rockies, who is dealing with lumbar pain. The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins.

The Royals also acquired RHP Aiden May in a trade with the Miami Marlins, while the Athletics received RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, failing to secure a win on the road. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the charge at the plate. Baty hit a home run and drove in four runs, while Brent Suter pitched three scoreless innings in relief.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win. Hunter Dobbins pitched 5.0 strong innings, striking out 6 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Giants' Daniel Susac Sidelined with Knee Injury**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. The injury occurred on August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
